case_title: Rohini Sudarshan Gangurde v. The State of Maharashtra & Anr.
neutral_facts: The accused, the wife of the deceased, was charged with abetment of suicide under Section 306 of the IPC. The deceased was found hanging in his home, and the mother of the deceased filed a complaint alleging harassment and abuse by the accused. The deceased had a child with the accused, and they had jointly purchased a house where they resided. The deceased was employed at a hospital. The complainant alleged that the accused harassed the deceased for money and to transfer the house into her name, sending vulgar messages and preventing the deceased from visiting his parents. Colleagues of the deceased also reported incidents of abuse. The accused claimed the deceased had a drinking problem and that the deceased may have committed suicide out of frustration. The police filed a chargesheet against the accused, but the trial court rejected her discharge application. The High Court dismissed the revision application, and the accused appealed to the Supreme Court.
